name: Defense
note: GDD Defense page. Engine: Regular funds every initiative, so the GDD's high-tier Domestic Security Deployment is the High tier's own per-turn effect. Tier effects apply every turn.

high.effects: [voss loyalty +0.5] [cartels capacity -2] [stability +0.5 @ ibira] [col -0.3 @ ibira] [flag: domestic_security = true]

initiatives.name: Ballistics Institute of Technology
initiatives.summary: A military research institute. Raises education in Tekoku and military strength over time.

initiatives.name: Modernise Border Staff
initiatives.summary: New boats, posts and equipment for the border units, especially in Ibira.

name: Justice, Interior & Labour
note: GDD Justice page. Judicial Strengthening's target (cartels or landowners) is chosen in p2-budget (flag judicial_target = 1 cartels / 2 landowners); per-turn effects use it.

initiatives.name: Judicial Strengthening
initiatives.summary: More prosecutors, judges and police in one area: the cartels (Ibira and the city peripheries) or the big landowners (Tapira and Mognagna).

initiatives.name: Anti-Corruption Department
initiatives.summary: An autonomous department that investigates public officials. It will look into the Capital Party's links with the cartels and the scheme involving Pelan Avros and OPP members.

initiatives.name: Labour Rights and Compact
initiatives.summary: A formal negotiation with the unions on wages and rights. Reduces the risk of strikes in Katanaí.
initiatives.once: [+1 WELF] [cv opinion +1] [cp opinion -1] [business opinion -1] [flag: labor_compact = true]

name: Intelligence
note: GDD Intelligence page. Cutting intelligence lowers the survival counter (GDD 7.2).

initiatives.name: Foreign Intelligence Shielding
initiatives.summary: Monitors foreign intelligence operations in Kunasai and identifies who is behind them.

initiatives.name: Domestic Monitoring Department
initiatives.summary: Surveillance capacity inside the country, including protection equipment for the President.

name: Planning & Development
note: Round 2 decision: in term 1 the Planning budget pays for the great project chosen in chapter 1 plus municipal works. High tier = accelerated schedule. Cutting Planning pauses the great project.

initiatives.name: The great project
initiatives.summary: Construction of the project chosen in January, at normal pace.

initiatives.name: Municipal works programme
initiatives.summary: Small roads, drainage and repairs requested by mayors across the country. Popular with deputies.

name: Health & Social Programmes
note: GDD Health page. Cutting the ministry crosses Dara's redline (transfers in Mognagna).

cut.effects: [dara loyalty -2] [pm opinion -0.5] [approval -1 @ mognagna, ibira] [flag: transfers_cut = true]

initiatives.name: Public Health System
initiatives.summary: New hospitals and clinics where there are none, with staff and medicines. Slow results; addresses tobacco-related illness and famine risk.

initiatives.name: Social Assistance and Transfers
initiatives.summary: Cash transfers to poor families, mainly in Mognagna and Ibira. Immediate effect on living conditions.

initiatives.name: Basic Education Expansion
initiatives.summary: Teachers and schools in Mognagna and Ibira. Results over many years; weakens local strongmen over time.

initiatives.name: Higher Education and Research
initiatives.summary: Universities, laboratories and research grants. Slows the departure of graduates; needed for clean mining in Ibira.

name: Chief of Staff
note: GDD leaves Chief of Staff initiatives undefined; these two are new (round 2).

initiatives.name: Coalition Liaison Office
initiatives.summary: Staff who manage daily relations with the parties and deputies. Makes congressional deals easier.

initiatives.name: Culture and Festivals Fund
initiatives.summary: Money for national and regional festivals and museums. Allows investment at the Mognagna Folk Festival and the Veldran Heritage Festival.
